about:
Amtech Systems, Inc. (ASYS) is headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Founded in 1981, the company operates as a global supplier of semiconductor equipment and materials through four wholly-owned subsidiaries: BTU International, Entrepix Inc., PR Hoffman™, and Intersurface Dynamics.

The company designs, manufactures, and sells capital equipment and consumables for semiconductor fabrication, advanced packaging, and electronics assembly. Its portfolio spans substrate processing — including lapping, polishing, cleaning, etching, and chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) — as well as thermal processing with belt furnaces, diffusion furnaces, and reflow ovens. Entrepix provides CMP outsourcing services, refurbished equipment, and OEM OnTrak cleaners, while BTU International supplies high-volume solder reflow systems for AI semiconductor packaging. Operations span eight locations in five countries.

Amtech serves the power semiconductor market across mobile, computing, industrial, automotive, telecom, and medical sectors. Its customers include integrated circuit fabricators, original equipment manufacturers, materials suppliers, defense contractors, and outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) providers. The company's high-volume reflow ovens are used by leading OSATs and OEMs for advanced packaging of AI semiconductor devices, while its CMP services support major IC fabricators and materials suppliers.

The company cites product quality and customer service as its primary differentiators, positioning itself as a trusted supplier of high-quality solutions. Its growth strategy centers on the silicon carbide and power semiconductor sectors, aiming to maximize revenue through optimization of existing businesses, rationalization of product lines, leveraging corporate capabilities, and strategic acquisitions.
